packages.name: ika-c-mag-hs7
packages.description: IKA C-MAG HS 7 magnetic stirrer hotplate over its USB/RS-232 port (NAMUR command set). Heating to 500 C, stirring to 1500 rpm.

packages.name: opentrons-flex
packages.description: Opentrons Flex liquid handler through PyLabRobot's Opentrons backend. Pipetting, tips, plate moves with the gripper.

packages.name: manual-benchtop-centrifuge
packages.description: Any benchtop centrifuge operated by a person. The agent instructs the operator (balance, speed, time) and records results. A template to copy for your own model.

packages.name: elveflow-ob1
packages.description: Elveflow OB1 pressure controller through the Elveflow SDK (Windows). Pressure per channel, flow feedback on an MFS flow sensor, vent.

packages.name: elveflow-mux-distributor
packages.description: Elveflow MUX Distributor rotary selection valve through the Elveflow SDK (Windows). Select which port feeds the common line.

packages.name: biologic-sp300
packages.description: BioLogic SP-300 potentiostat through easy-biologic and the EC-Lab Development Package (Windows). OCV, static and pulsed chronopotentiometry, CV, with a live potential relay.

packages.name: wasatch-raman-blaze
packages.description: Wasatch Photonics Raman spectrometer (Wasatch.PY) behind a BlazeMetrics Blaze probe. Single spectra and time series with band intensities; laser gated on a person.

packages.name: sri-8610c-gc
packages.description: SRI 8610C gas chromatograph through PeakSimple's .NET connector (Windows). Runs a saved control file and returns the peak table.
